structural_change: NEW leaf (MU-LEAF-KIT 10-19, MU-QW-B1 4b): the Qwen ROM 4-user op-start observer leaf qfd_sys_face_mu_dhuser NU 4 OPSEG 1 PINREG 1 hardened on its own: one ot_rom_4096x72_m8 (v2 aligned, F16 image rom/qfd_tt_ctlm_opseg.viamap.hex, content-independent macro; ROM instance parameters dropped under SYNTHESIS) 20 um from the E edge (its E face carries PG rects: macro_edge rule) with its W pin edge toward a W std-cell band (~200 flops: fc/tc 44, prefetch entry ~55, outputs 31, header ~56), all pins on the W face, ck mid-face beside the register band. PINREG 1 (opt-in, default 0 unchanged): pin flop on dh_run[42:36], compensated anchor, op starts cycle-identical. MU-LEAF-KIT2 10-19: (1) PINREG 1 lands ROM rd_out in a 72-flop capture register rq before any decode (gate k1 TT -134 ps: rom_q -> header/entry decode -> regs and -> ROM address); op starts unchanged (fire edge t_rom), compiler LEAF_MIN_GAP 2 -> 3 (F16 image min gap 7, unchanged). (2) pins spread over the full W face (3..66.5 um) with per-port pin_ranges + pin_balance (dh_run low, ck/rst_n mid, outputs high) instead of one region bunched low. MU-LEAF-PSM 10-19: outline h 69.12 -> 71.28 (+2.16 um). Route k2-e8b9f03f0 failed 6_report PSM-0069 (VDD connectivity): the ROM (62.95 um + 2 um PDN/row halo) spanned the full 64.8 um core height, so the 20-um E gutter's M1/M2 rails and its 3 M5 VDD/VSS stripe pairs were an island cut off from the W band (no M1-M4 path across the ROM, M5 is vertical only). The taller core leaves std-cell rows above the ROM whose followpin rails cross the full width and land on every M5 stripe (W band, over-ROM, E gutter) -> one VDD and one VSS grid inside the tile.
